product.name: Ledgerly
product.description: Bookkeeping SaaS for sole traders, with a companion mobile app for receipts.

assumptions: EU and UK consumers are in scope because pricing is shown in EUR and GBP.
limitations: No access to the payment provider dashboard.
No production credentials; destructive and live-payment tests not run.

summary: Illustrative example only. Ledgerly's identity and data isolation are solid on the web app, but a service-role key ships in the mobile bundle and the production smoke test has not been run.

checks.evidence: gitleaks detect over the working tree and 412 commits: 0 findings.
EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY is read in app/lib/db.ts:4 and present in the built bundle.
curl -I shows HSTS max-age=31536000; no mixed content on core pages.
CSP set but includes 'unsafe-inline' for scripts.
Replayed 23 object requests with account B's session: all 404.
20 failed logins in 60 s on staging: no delay, no lockout.
Admin MFA enforcement is configured in the auth provider dashboard, which was not accessible.

findings.title: Service-role key shipped in the mobile app
findings.evidence: app/lib/db.ts:4 reads EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY; the key string is present in the release bundle.
findings.user_impact: Anyone who unpacks the app can read and modify every user's books.
findings.business_impact: Total data breach risk; store removal; regulator notification under GDPR.
findings.recommendation: Rotate the key now. Move privileged operations behind authenticated server endpoints; the app uses only the anon key with row-level security.
findings.validation: Key absent from a fresh release bundle; old key revoked; RLS tests pass with the anon key.

findings.title: No brute-force protection on login
findings.evidence: 20 failed attempts in 60 s accepted on staging.
findings.user_impact: Accounts with weak passwords can be guessed.
findings.recommendation: Add per-account and per-IP rate limiting with progressive delay on login and reset.
findings.validation: The 6th failed attempt within a minute returns 429.
